subject.title: bug: subagent announce direct-send error silently swallowed when queue fallback recovers

question: Should maintainers clear this issue for a narrow phase-aware warning fix now that the overlapping queue-first completion announce PR is closed, or keep it paused for a broader announce-delivery redesign?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the existing no-new-fix-pr and maintainer-review labels are an explicit pause on automatic fix PR creation.

options.title: Allow narrow warning fix
options.body: Clear the pause and let one focused PR log recovered direct-primary completion errors with targeted tests.

options.title: Keep paused for redesign
options.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer-owned announce-delivery redesign decides the permanent dispatch order and diagnostics.

options.title: Decline recovered-failure logging
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally decide successful fallback delivery should not warn about failed direct attempts.

recommendation.title: Allow narrow warning fix
recommendation.body: Clear the pause and let one focused PR log recovered direct-primary completion errors with targeted tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the unified dispatch surface and authored the closed queue-first PR that overlapped this landing decision.
